abstract: The World Economic Forum's Future of Jobs Report 2025 analyzes AI's differential impact across education sector roles, finding that core teaching positions remain relatively protected while support functions face moderate displacement risk. Administrative and content creation roles emerge as most vulnerable to AI adoption in the education sector.
keyFindings: Core teaching roles remain protected from significant displacement risk due to AI adoption
Education support roles face moderate displacement risk from AI technologies
Administrative roles are among the most affected job categories in the education sector
Content creation roles face significant disruption from AI adoption
qualifiers: The provided excerpt represents limited content; full methodology and specific quantitative findings from the complete report are not available in the source text provided.
